ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, a pair of set squares is overlaid. Given that $\angle OAB=\angle OCD=90^\circ$, $\angle AOB=45^\circ$, and $\angle COD=60^\circ$, with $OB$ bisecting $\angle COD$, what is the measurement of $\angle AOC$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that OB bisects $\angle$COD and $\angle$COD = 60°,\\
it follows that $\angle$BOC = 30°,\\
and since $\angle$AOB = 45°,\\
it implies $\angle$AOC = $\angle$AOB - $\angle$BOC = 45° - 30° = \boxed{15^\circ}.
